outcome: A spell with gift can be cast with an opponent chosen as an additional cost, which promises the gift.
A gift permanent triggers on entering only if its gift cost was paid, and a gift instant or sorcery applies its gift effect only if it was.
A give-a-gift trigger fires when a gifted spell resolves or a gift triggered ability resolves.
The chosen player creates a Food token.
The chosen player draws a card.
The chosen player creates a tapped 1/1 blue Fish token.
The chosen player takes an extra turn after this one.
The chosen player creates a Treasure token.
The chosen player creates an 8/8 blue Octopus token.
A gifted instant or sorcery applies its gift effect before its other effects, and not at all if countered.
A spell cast with the gift cost declared has its gift promised.
A gift-conditional part of a spell with targets only has those targets when the gift was promised.
